description: Watches: configure, unfurl and save free. The free standard Watches, each with every coordinate explicit and a `reading` state (`available`: it has a reading today; `not-yet-projected`: configurable and free to unfurl, but it answers cannot-measure until its reading is built), plus the published terms: saving is free up to the cap (read from the tariff), what it includes, and its limits. Free; no key. Same content as GET /api/v1/watches/standard.
name: list_standard_watches
